description: List the CI runners registered to an owner (username, org slug, or 'platform'): id, name, url, labels, slots, online, last seen, revoked; allowSharedOverflow (the setting); and sharedLane, whether the owner's jobs actually run on shared runners: 'used (no own runners)', 'overflow allowed' or 'not used (own runners only)', explained in sharedLaneDetail. Needs a PAT with 'repo' scope (or a session) and the right to manage the owner's runners. For a read-only credential — a security audit watching for rogue runners — mint a repository token with {"runners": "read"} (gluecron_create_repo_token) and call GET /api/v2/repos/:owner/:repo/actions/runners: it lists the same runners and lane and can do nothing else (repository tokens are not accepted on /mcp).
name: gluecron_list_runners
